description: This file implements a custom entry point for managing authentication failures in a Spring Security context. It handles unauthorized access attempts by sending an HTTP 401 response.

classes.name: ServicesAuthenticationEntryPoint
classes.description: A custom implementation of Spring Security's AuthenticationEntryPoint that responds with a 401 Unauthorized error when authentication fails.

methods.name: commence
methods.description: Handles authentication failures by sending an HTTP 401 Unauthorized response.
